notes: ShiftToken mints 1,000,000,000 NIGHTSHIFT (SHIFT), with 18 decimals, once to msg.sender in its constructor. Ordinary transfers and transferFrom burn 1% of the gross SHIFT amount, rounded down to minor units, and credit the remainder to the recipient; transferFrom consumes allowance for the gross amount. Transfers whose sender or recipient is the factory or this launch's distributor, and transfers whose recipient is the pool manager, are delivered in full with nothing burned; what the pool manager pays out (a buy) is taxed like any other transfer. The distributor is resolved at transfer time through factory.distributorOf(launchNumber); if that call fails, no distributor is exempt. There are no application contracts, subsequent minting, or administrative controls. The pool pairs with IMD at a 1.25% pool fee. initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the initial market cap and total supply.
